name: Mr. Knight

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Light Proficiency: Hafif saldırılar sırasında saldırı gücünü belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Tranquilize: Debuff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Injury: Yaralı bir rakibe vurmak, onun fiziksel direncini belirtilen yüzdede azaltır.
abilityDetails.Panic: Etkilenen şampiyonlar Kaçış (Evade) yapamaz veya saldırıları ıskalatamaz.
abilityDetails.Reckless: Ağır saldırı kullanma şansını artırır, blok vuran saldırılarda saldırı gücünü azaltır.
abilityDetails.Sleep: Uyuyan şampiyonlar saldıramaz, bloklayamaz veya hareket edemez; vurulduklarında bu etki kalkar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Rakip negatif efekt uygularsa acımasızca cezalandırır. 12sn'de bir tranquilize uygular (4 debuff engellenirse pasif uyku uygular, 3sn tamamen savunmasız kalırsın). Onu siperleme de — sersemletme debuff'ı uygular. Kimse tranquilize'a immün değil; pasif sersemletme erişimi olan ve negatif efekt uygulamayan şampiyon en iyisi — çoğu durumda onu hiç siperlememek tercih edilir.
signatureAbility:
Case Closed
Whenever one or more of the Opponent's Debuffs fail to trigger due to reduced Ability Accuracy, they gain [5 - 25] Sleep Charges (rounded down). As a Defender, this includes Debuffs from Quest Nodes on Mr. Knight.
1.5 seconds after reaching 100 Charges, inflict a Sleep Passive for 3 seconds and remove 100 Charges. Cooldown: 6 seconds. The timer to inflict this Sleep is paused during any Special Attack.
As a Defender, when the Attacker activates a Special Attack, they lose 25 Sleep Charges per level of the Special Attack.
As an Attacker in Battlegrounds, at the start of each fight inflict 2 10% Injury Passives for [4 - 12] seconds.

abilitySections.title: Khonshu's Protection
content: While Mr. Knight is Blocking, the Opponent's Attack Rating during hits is capped at 90% of what it was at the start of the fight. While he is Dodging back, the cap is 30%.
Whenever Mr. Knight's Dexterity Mastery fails to activate from an incoming attack, he gains an Unstoppable Passive for 0.75 seconds.
While the Opponent is Sleeping, Mr. Knight does not idle. He doesn't want to waste the opportunity.

abilitySections.title: Phases of Combat
content: Mr. Knight cycles through different Moon Phases during combat. Each Phase lasts 12 seconds before moving to the next Phase. The order of the Phases are: Waning Moon, New Moon, Waxing Moon, Full Moon, then back to Waning Moon.
While the Moon is Full, Light Attacks and Special Attacks are Guaranteed Critical Hits, and Critical Hits land through Block.
While the Moon is Waxing or Waning, Light Attacks gain +[687.5] Critical Rating.
Whenever the Moon Phase changes, gain a +[7,271.51] Light Proficiency Passive for 18 seconds. Max: 6.

abilitySections.title: Tranquilize
content: Mr. Knight's Well-Timed Blocks inflict a 10% Tranquilize Debuff for 15 seconds. Max: 5.
As a Defender, whenever the Moon Phase changes, inflict a 10% Tranquilize Passive for 15 seconds.
If the Opponent is not a Mutant, the Ability Accuracy of their non-Damaging Debuffs is further reduced by 25% per personal Tranquilize on them. Only affects Champion Abilities and Masteries.

abilitySections.title: Crack the Case
content: Attacking the Opponent while they are Sleeping, or are charging or performing a Heavy or Special Attack inflicts an indefinite 10% Injury Passive. Doing so with a Light Attack inflicts 1 additional Injury. Max: 10.

Inflicting 1 or more Injury in this way triggers a cooldown of 10 seconds. When a personal Injury would be inflicted while the cooldown is active, instead shorten the cooldown by 4 seconds per attempted Injury.
When the Opponent is Inflicted with an Injury effect, if they have at least…
1+, refresh 2 personal Light Proficiency Passives.
2+, inflict a Panic Debuff for 15 seconds.
4+, inflict 1 personal Tranquilize Debuff. Against Science Champions, this triggers at 3 or more Injuries instead.
5+, inflict a non-stacking 30% Reckless Debuff for 10 seconds. This Reckless is removed the next time the Opponent charges a Heavy attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit grants 2 personal Light Proficiency Passives.
If the Moon Phase changed during this attack, the final hit inflicts a Sleep Passive for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, the next time Full Moon activates or if it is already active, pause it and all personal Light Proficiency Passives for 12 seconds.
As a Defender, on activation inflict 2 personal Tranquilize Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a non-stacking Regeneration Buff, restoring 1% of Max Health over 9 seconds. Potency is increased by 150% while below 50% Health. This is refreshed when the Moon Phase changes or a personal Injury is inflicted.
Refresh all personal Tranquilize and Light Proficiency effects.
